name: Paper cut and papercraft
look: layered coloured paper with real thickness shadows, scissor edges, folds, stepped motion.

fits.notes: storytelling, education, nature, human brands, craft

type.guidance: cut-letter type (Cooper-ish, Ginto Nord, hand-cut), paper palettes with 2 neutrals + 3 saturated.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: cut-letter type (Cooper-ish, Ginto Nord, hand-cut), paper palettes with 2 neutrals + 3 saturated.
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: brand colour is one of the 3 saturated papers; 2 neutrals around it
brand_lock.type_role: cut-letter display for headlines, brand face for the claim
brand_lock.world_changes: layered paper with real thickness shadows; honest that it is digital paper unless Codex plates are used
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

hints: layers slide in with shadow growth
motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: cut-paper {subject} illustration on flat colour, layered with thickness shadows, scissor edges, paper texture, plain background
codex_assets.r1_note: paper textures, cut-out illustrations on flat colour, fold sheets; A1 + A2.
codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

build.recipe: `runtime/medium-paper.js`, `systems/material/paper-cut-and-papercraft.md`, `library/motion/collage/paper-cutout-parallax-2-5d.md`. SVG polygons + drop shadows with growing blur; `stepFps` option exists.

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.

palettes.name: Craft layers
palettes.words: warm cream card, aubergine-black, vermilion, deep sea blue

palettes.name: Forest cutout
palettes.words: pale mint paper, forest ink, marigold, brick red

palettes.name: Night paper
palettes.words: indigo card, moon cream, saffron, rose

brand_lock.rule: Brand colour is the hero paper layer (the character or sun); at most 2 other layers, style-fixed. Slots marked brand take the brand colour (exact hex); slots marked style keep the palette value; brand-or-style takes the brand colour only when its contrast against the other slot is at least 4.5:1, else the palette value.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: Soft heavy serif set with a 4 px hard paper drop-shadow, as if cut from card.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

type.load: In a HyperFrames composition add the two <link> tags from `google` to <head> (plus rel=preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), set font-family from `css`, and wait for document.fonts.ready before the first screenshot / timeline build. Offline renders: download the families once (they are OFL) into the project's fonts/ folder and use @font-face. The brand face always sets the real claim line and the product UI text; the style pairing is for the world's chrome and display.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text. Under a brand lock keep the brand face for the claim and use the pairing's display for labels only.

finish.how: Runtime: RasanFX.create({ source, passes: [...] }) from runtime/rasan-fx.js, applied in the listed order, on the whole composition canvas or on the Codex plate only (plate-only when the type must stay crisp). `css` lists the cheap approximation kinds story boards and style frames draw with plain CSS (grain:<opacity>, scan:<opacity>, halftone, pixel, led-dots ...).

composition.grid: 4-7 stacked paper layers with 2-3% parallax offsets; each layer a flat cut-out with a hard edge shadow
composition.safe_area: 10% margin; foreground layer bleeds off one edge
composition.fill: layers fill the frame; focal layer 45% of height
composition.product_ui: UI sits on a paper 'card' layer with the same hard shadow; the UI itself stays crisp

codex.template: {subject} {action}, {setting}. Camera and lens: straight-on top-down layered diorama with a slight 8-degree tilt, 35 mm. Lighting: one soft key from upper left; each layer casts a short crisp shadow onto the layer below. Material: matte cardstock with visible cut edges, slight deckle at curves, fibre texture. Colour, locked to the palette {palette_words}, and nothing outside it. Texture and finish: paper fibre grain, soft edge shadows, tiny cut-edge bevel; no gradients inside shapes. Avoid: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no gradients inside shapes, no glossy surfaces, no vector-clean edges without shadow, no photoreal people.
codex.camera: straight-on top-down layered diorama with a slight 8-degree tilt, 35 mm
codex.lighting: one soft key from upper left; each layer casts a short crisp shadow onto the layer below
codex.material: matte cardstock with visible cut edges, slight deckle at curves, fibre texture
codex.colour_rule: Name the palette's colours in words (the palette's `words`), never hex codes; add 'and nothing outside this palette'. Pick one palette per film and keep it.
codex.texture: paper fibre grain, soft edge shadows, tiny cut-edge bevel; no gradients inside shapes

aspect.note: Plates: ask for about 12% bleed around the frame so the camera can travel; keep the calm side empty for type. Generate 16:9 for the frame, 1:1 for sprite sheets and objects.

consistency.anchor: Make the anchor plate first, approve it by eye, then pass it as --ref to every other image (imagegen batch does this with --world).
consistency.style_line: Append the world bible's style line (30-45 words, no hex) to every prompt.
consistency.seed_words: Keep these words verbatim in every prompt of the film: matte cardstock with visible cut edges; straight-on top-down layered diorama with a slight 8-degree tilt; warm cream card, aubergine-black, vermilion, deep sea blue.

sprite_sheet.rules: Not a sprite style. For a cut-out object or character use --transparent (flat #00FF00 key, then despill); one subject, no shadow plane.

do: Every shape is flat colour with a shadow carrying the depth
Layer order and offset tell the depth, not blur
Keep curves gently imperfect, like hand-cut
dont: No shadows without a source direction
No more than 3 paper tones per layer family
cheap_ways: Vector flat art with a drop shadow filter slapped on
Layers that never move relative to each other
